remarks: Some homes are simply houses, and some have spent decades collecting stories. Welcome to 929 E. Renton Street, offered for the first time since 1960 and lovingly cared for through the years. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath Carson home offers approximately 1,130 square feet of living space on a generous 5,439-square-foot lot, with the kind of warmth, character and opportunity that’s getting harder to find. Step inside to freshly painted interiors and original wood floors that bring instant charm and a sense of history.
